env.note: machine shared, load about 7-10: wall times are indicative only, right-hand-side counts are exact

oscillator.problem: x'' = -x, x(0)=1, v(0)=0, t in [0, 20 pi] (ten periods); exact (cos t, -sin t); atol = 1e-2 rtol; err = max-norm at t_end

prothero_robinson.problem: y' = -lam (y - cos t) - sin t, y(0) = 1, t in [0, 10]; exact y = cos t; rtol 1e-6, atol 1e-8

amplitude_vs_time.note: each point is an independent CvodeSolver.solve(rhs, 0, y0, t_k); |(x, v)| = 1 exactly

decay_adams_fix.problem: y' = -y, t in [0, 10], atol 1e-14, relative error of y(10)
